description:
Merge a segment with an adjacent one (segment numbers must be
    neighbors). keep: "this" | "other" — whose creative data survives: its
    assets are kept (rendered frame/clip marked stale against the combined
    narration and its prompts re-derived); the other segment's assets are
    deleted. Later segments renumber — re-check get_segments before further
    edits.

dry_run.description: True previews the consequences without changing anything
dry_run.title: Dry Run

keep.description: Whose creative data survives the merge: "this" (segment_number) or "other" (with_segment_number)
keep.title: Keep

project_id.description: Project ID, as returned by create_project or list_projects
project_id.title: Project Id

segment_number.description: 1-based segment number, as reported by get_segments
segment_number.title: Segment Number

with_segment_number.description: 1-based number of the adjacent segment to merge with (must neighbor segment_number)
with_segment_number.title: With Segment Number

name: combine_segments
title: Combine segments
